show.description: Once a world champion racer, Sanjay loses everything after a sabotage by his envious adoptive brother Shourya, leading to his father’s death. Homeless and broken, Sanjay gets a new chance when Ananya rescues him and unknowingly hires him as a mechanic. As fate unfolds, Sanjay re-enters the racing world under disguise, restores his identity, and defeats Shourya in a breathtaking championship finale—redeeming his legacy and exposing his brother’s deceit. Watch now.
